role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 潮汐猎人昂首阔步地走在队伍的前面，他总是在留意出手的时机。时机来临时，他会释放毁灭性的终极技能，为盟友留下一堆头晕目眩的敌人任他们宰割。
hero_summary_en: Stalking ahead of his team, Tidehunter is always on the lookout for the right time to strike. When the moment comes, he unleashes his massive and devastating ultimate, paving the way for his allies to slay their stunned enemies.

abilities.name: tidehunter_gush
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
abilities.description_en: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.

scepter_loc.en: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。

abilities.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell
abilities.description_zh:
加厚潮汐猎人的外皮，可以被动格挡物理伤害。对非英雄单位的格挡伤害有所减少。潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过临界值后还将移除负面的状态效果。

可以主动开启，以%active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%%移动速度的代价使伤害格挡量加倍。持续%active_duration%秒。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
facet_text_en: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
facet_text_zh: 锚击效果下的敌方英雄阵亡会使海妖外壳获得永久伤害格挡。

abilities.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
abilities.description_zh: 潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + %additional_range%。
abilities.description_en: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
notes_zh: 锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
abilities.description_zh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚%chain_length%距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至%max_movement_speed%，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚承受%attacks_to_destroy%次英雄攻击后会被摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.

abilities.name: tidehunter_ravage
abilities.description_zh: 猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并眩晕附近所有敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
notes_zh: 毁灭以%speed%的速度向外扩散。
notes_en: Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.

abilities.name: tidehunter_leviathans_catch
abilities.description_zh: 每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得%fish_health_bonus%点最大生命值，%fish_attack_range%攻击距离和%fish_damage_block%额外伤害格挡。潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。
abilities.description_en: Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
notes_zh: 额外伤害格挡只会在有伤害格挡来源施加给即将受到的物理攻击时才会施加
notes_en: Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_tidehunter_smash_on_blubber
talents_raw.name_loc: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash
talents_raw.desc_loc: Triggered attack has {s:bonus_smash_on_purge}% damage and is reflected damage.
